correctness.rationale: Only a can lower rank, by at most one, and a shortest word to deficiency s ends at its s-th effective a. Immediately after an effective a, state n is missing, so separators between consecutive effective a's cannot have length zero; length two is impossible, and a length-one separator must be b. After an aba rank drop, both 1 and n are holes, so another one-letter separator would move a hole to 2 and make the next a ineffective. Hence adjacent separator lengths sum to at least four. Pairing separators gives 3s-2 for odd s and 3s-3 for even s. The proposed alternating ba/b^3a witnesses have the explicitly stated hole sets; the half-range hypothesis prevents wraparound and keeps every a effective. Fresh independent power-automaton BFS reproduced the formula for every allowed s at n=5,7,9,11,13, while the frozen verifier extends exact BFS through n=17 and witness replay through n=301. The symbolic separator/hole proof establishes all odd n.
